title: Automate changelog and onboard aurora-lite-3b v1.3 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Onboard aurora-lite-3b v1.3: add metadata, validated performance profiles for common seq lengths, and enable automated changelog generation for model registry releases.
description: Motivation: customers running latency-sensitive workloads requested a smaller, latency-optimized variant of Aurora with updated tokenizer/metadata and validated perf profiles. This PR does two related things: 1) add aurora-lite-3b v1.3 model metadata and performance profiles; 2) extend the model-registry changelog automation so onboarding events automatically produce draft release notes and link perf artifacts. Changes are intentionally small and script-driven to keep manual work minimal. What I changed: - model-metadata/aurora-lite-3b/v1.3/metadata.yaml: canonical metadata (author, license, quantization-recommendation, tokenizer, signature). - model-metadata/aurora-lite-3b/v1.3/perf-profiles/seq128.json, seq512.json, seq1024.json: measured throughput/latency profiles with test harness IDs. - scripts/onboard_model.py: onboarding helper updated to validate perf profiles and emit changelog fragment to .changelogs/auto/. - tools/changelog-generator.py: add support for model:onboard event and template variables (model, version, perf-summary, test-artifacts-url). - tests/test_onboard_workflow.py: integration tests mocked against perf artifacts. Checklist: - [x] Metadata validated against schema - [x] Perf profiles generated from perf-lab run 2026-02-15 - [x] Changelog fragment generated and linted - [x] Unit + integration tests pass - [x] Reviewed and approved by infra and product Notes for reviewers: pay attention to perf profile units (ms/token vs p50 latency) and the changelog template variables. If we later add region-specific buckets we'll keep the same event fields. How to test locally: run `python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && python scripts/onboard_model.py --model aurora-lite-3b --version v1.3 --perf-artifact tests/fixtures/aurora-lite-3b-v1.3-perf.json --dry-run`. Production rollout: triggers the same automation that creates a draft changelog entry in the registry repo under .changelogs/auto/ and opens a Linear task (ENG-3421) for product to verify wording before publishing.
